summary: The diff clearly implements the storefront fetch error vs empty-catalog distinction (including the exact toast text) and adds premium empty/error state components with admin-only CTA logic. However, based on the truncated backend diff, durable stable-memory product persistence and admin product list CRUD backing cannot be confirmed. The diff also introduces several extra frontend/background/routing and backend admin utility changes that were not explicitly requested in Phase 3 requirements.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement durable product persistence in the Motoko canister using stable storage so products survive reloads and canister upgrades, while keeping single-actor logic in backend/main.mo (migration.mo only if needed).
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and does not show stable variables, preupgrade/postupgrade hooks, or the product CRUD implementation wired to stable storage; migration.mo exists but its use from upgrade hooks is not evidenced in the truncated main.mo diff.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no visible stable storage hooks/product CRUD)

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend product APIs must support fields (name, price, description, images, fabric, variants, blousePair, category) and publicListProducts/adminListProducts must return persisted products with correct auth behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: Although backend/migration.mo defines product fields matching the requirement, the backend API surface (publicListProducts/adminListProducts) and authorization behavior are not visible in the truncated backend/main.mo diff, so full support and behavior cannot be verified from this diff summary alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure admin panel product list shows all persisted products and supports edit/delete actions backed by canister persistence; deletions/edits persist after refresh and reflect in storefront.
missing_requirements.reason: No admin panel product list page/components or admin CRUD UI wiring is shown in the provided diffs. Release notes claim this behavior, but the diff summary does not include the relevant admin UI/backend call sites to verify it.
evidence: frontend/RELEASE_NOTES.md (claims behavior, but no admin UI diff shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a Phase 3 verification step in documentation/release notes: after deployment, provide draft/live URL and a checklist confirming persistence and error/empty states.
missing_requirements.reason: A checklist file was added, but the URLs are placeholders (“To be filled after deployment”) and the requirement specifically asks to provide the draft/live URL after deployment.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend admin-only method confirmDeploymentChecks() returning a text confirmation string.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any Phase 3 requirement; REQ-44 asks for documentation/checklist, not a canister method.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend admin-only method processAdminCommand(cmd) that echoes a command string.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by Phase 3 requirements; appears to be extra admin utility functionality.

hallucinated_features.description: New /size-chart route and a dummy size chart page referenced in frontend routing.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of Phase 3 scope (persistence + fetch error/empty states + admin list correctness) and may violate the “minimal UI necessary” constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Significant enhancements/changes to animated background components (OceanBackground/SangamBackground) beyond Phase 3 needs.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by Phase 3 requirements and not necessary for persistence/error/empty-state/admin CRUD fixes.

hallucinated_features.description: Header/Footer behavior and navigation changes (always-visible profile icon, separate Sign In/Sign Up buttons, logout button behavior, and hiding on admin routes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by Phase 3 requirements and could be considered beyond the minimal UI changes allowed.
